assessment_method: Code and saved-artifact audit. These 28 compound questions have not been run as a new end-to-end evaluation. Partial checks are narrower than the family; counts are not answer accuracy.
analysis_scope: Five banks: Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Citi and Capital One. Six frozen Q2 2025 documents with selected Q2 2024 comparisons. Core reviewed consumer revenue/expense inputs cover all five banks. Q1 is not currently accepted by scope resolution.

items.question: How does ROTCE compare across peers this quarter, and how much is driven by one-time items?
items.existing_checks: JPM reported ROTCE has source-labelled retrieval checks only; no adjusted peer-answer validation.
gaps: Both-bank coverage and notable-item reconciliation are not validated.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Verify reported and adjusted figures separately; require attributable income, average tangible equity and annualization before computing adjustments.
items.next_step: Freeze both-bank reported ROTCE cases before adding adjusted returns.

items.question: What is each bank's return on assets, and how much is driven by balance sheet mix rather than profitability?
items.existing_checks: JPM consolidated reported ROA was checked in the selected live-answer sample.
gaps: Peer coverage and mix attribution are not validated.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Reject return on allocated capital as ROA; require disclosed evidence for mix attribution.
items.next_step: Validate reported ROA for each bank; separate attribution into another case.

items.question: How much of the year-over-year change in earnings comes from revenue, expenses, and provisions?
items.existing_checks: Selected net-income lookups have retrieval checks; these do not validate an earnings bridge.
gaps: No reconciled earnings bridge or exceptional-item treatment.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Include tax and other reconciliation effects; separate reported and normalized changes.
items.next_step: Define bridge inputs and notable-item reconciliations.

items.question: What is each bank's net interest margin, and which way is it moving?
items.existing_checks: No family-specific end-to-end answer validation recorded.
gaps: Bank-specific yield series and trend calculations are not validated.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Keep including/excluding Markets separate and verify matched periods and denominators.
items.next_step: Review exact margin/yield labels and freeze bank-specific series.

items.question: How sensitive is NII to a 100bp rate move?
items.existing_checks: No family-specific end-to-end answer validation recorded.
gaps: No reviewed shock scenario, horizon or assumption mapping.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Display shock path, horizon and model assumptions; do not imply identical scenarios.
items.next_step: Add and review rate-risk disclosures before enabling comparisons.

acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Compare issued-at dates and identical horizon and Markets scope; attribute forecasts to management.
items.next_step: Add current and prior-quarter presentations or transcripts.

acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Match deposit populations and average/end balances; preserve segment definitions.
items.next_step: Audit existing Q1 columns before expanding period metadata and calculation support.

acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Match GAAP/FTE/managed bases; calculate leverage with validated inputs and state percentage-point units.

items.question: How fast are expenses growing compared with revenue, and how much of that growth is technology spending or headcount?

gaps: Technology/headcount attribution and consolidated coverage are unvalidated.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Use source-disclosed causal attribution; headcount change alone does not establish expense causality.
items.next_step: Keep growth calculations and management-attributed explanations as separate cases.

items.question: How does consumer segment revenue and margin compare?

gaps: Margin definition and input validation are missing.
acceptance_checks: Preserve bank, business scope, period, units and reporting basis; cite each material claim.
Require an explicit margin definition; preserve reported segment scope and selected comparison denominator.
items.next_step: Keep validated revenue comparison and clarify the requested margin before extending.
